text:
maya-marketing: Heads up — noticed ~120 leads in the last hour that skipped owner assignment because enrichment webhook lagged and HubSpot fallback kicked in. not a full outage but high enough to matter :grimacing:
sam-sdr: ugh. are those going to the default queue or stuck as unassigned?
maya-marketing: default owner set -> some high-touch reps got flooded. skews routing metrics and lead quality handoff.
ryan-growth: timeline? what caused enrichment lag? did ML batch back up?
ophelia-ops: saw a spike on the enrichment worker CPU and retries. looks like downstream SFDC API throttles slowed KV cache warmups.
hubspot-bot: Integration alert: 3 consecutive enrichment webhook timeouts for app/redwood-enrich. Payload size ~4KB.
maya-marketing: thinking quick fix: add a short grace window in HubSpot workflow — wait 30s for enrichment tag before applying round-robin fallback. low-risk toggle.
sam-sdr: +1 for grace window. We lose some SLA but better than misrouting to heavy hitters. can we do 30s safely?
ophelia-ops: 30s is reasonable as emergency. propose implementing as a workflow condition + backoff on our side. I'll draft the HubSpot change and a canary for EMEA only.
ryan-growth: also add an observability metric: % leads that hit fallback vs assigned after enrichment. need to track regressions post-rollout.
ophelia-ops: agreed. quick query to surface current state: `SELECT count(*) FROM leads WHERE owner_id = 'default' AND created_at > now() - interval '1 hour';` add enrichment_delay_ms histogram.
maya-marketing: i'll notify SDR leads about temporary routing tweak and ask them to hold urgent follow-ups for 30m.
hubspot-bot: Suggestion: use `hs_event.enrichment_received` boolean in workflow checks. fallback only if false after 30s.
ophelia-ops: plan: 1) patch workflow (EMEA) with 30s grace 2) deploy dedupe/backoff on enrich worker 3) monitor fallback% and queue spike 4) rollback if fallback% > 10% after 10m.
ryan-growth: Can we make the grace window configurable per-geo? APAC has longer API latency.
ophelia-ops: yes, we'll param by region. default 30s, APAC 45s.
sam-sdr: any manual remediation for leads that already misrouted?
maya-marketing: can export owners list and reassign top 50 by lead score. i'll handle communications.
deploy-bot: Deploy scheduled: hubspot/workflows/grace-window -> canary(EMEA) at 3923456805 by ophelia-ops.
ophelia-ops: rolled out canary. monitoring dashboards updated. ping me if you see misroutes.
maya-marketing: thanks all — follow-up in 30m with metrics. :thumbsup:
